name: IBY_TRANSMIT_PARAMETERS_B_
description: IBY_TRANSMIT_PARAMETERS stores a transmission protocol's input parameters. For example, this table is used to indicate that the FTP protocol requires a destination IP address and a destination directory, among other parameters. It is referred to by the transmission configuration table.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_PARAMETER_CODE
columns.description: User-entered primary key.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_PARAMETER_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the parameter. Values, from the lookup IBY_PARAMETER_TYPES, include VARCHAR2, NUMBER, and DATE.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_PROTOCOL_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the transmission protocol for which this parameter is needed

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether this parameter is mandatory.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether this parameter is dynamically generated using transactional data.

columns.name: DYN_CODE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Language of the code that is used for dynamic parameter value generation. Possible values would be 'PL/SQL' and 'Java'.

columns.name: DYN_CODE_PACKAGE
columns.description: Package used for dynamic parameter value generation; in PL/SQL this corresponds to a package name, in Java a class name

columns.name: DYN_CODE_ENTRY_POINT
columns.description: Code entry point used for dynamic parameter value generation. For example, this could be in the form of a PL/SQL package and procedure, or a Java class and method.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Display order within the set of all options for protocol

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SECURED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the parameter should be secured-i.e. is sensitive

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
